snippet.title: 9 Kings Mobile - Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare to fight for your kingdom: 9 Kings is coming to mobile Q4 2026! Pre-register on Google Play or pre-order it on the App Store now to get a special 10% off launch price!

Expand your empire, craft your deck, fight massive battles and break the game with insane builds to become the King of Kings in this fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder.


👑 Play as one of nine kings, each with their own playstyle: stockpile gold to hire thousands of mercenaries, harness the forces of nature, warp the laws of time, dabble in dark magic or raise hordes of fiendish imps ready to fight for you

​🏰 Grow your citadel as you strategically place your cards to expand your territory, upgrade buildings and towers, recruit new troops and boost them by stacking effects and spells

🃏​ Craft your deck carefully by looting rival kings to combine their unique cards with yours and create new powerful synergies

⚔️​ Protect your kingdom as long as you can against increasingly powerful enemies and attempt to break the game with insane builds as you endure decades of war, strife and unpredictable events

​🗺️ Enjoy endless replayability in this roguelike autobattler: every run is different, mastery comes from experimentation and new ground can be conquered through unique challenges in Quest Mode

​💥 Climb the ranks, customize your look and prove yourself to truly be the king of kings as you battle eight rivals in async multiplayer

Pre-register it now on Google Play: http://bit.ly/9Kings-PreRegAndroid
Pre-order it now on iOS:  http://bit.ly/9Kings-PreOrdiOS

Learn more about the game:  https://playdigious.com/games/9-kings
